resources.string: FolioLink installs only firmware signed with the Folio key: the image needs its .bin.sig signature file next to it.
The firmware is uploaded to the reader, which checks it and asks you to confirm on its screen. Don’t turn the reader off during installation.
Current version: %1$s. You’ll confirm the installation on the reader; it takes 1–2 minutes.
Battery %1$d%%. Connect the charger before updating.
No signature file (.bin.sig). FolioLink does not install unsigned firmware.
The signature file is damaged: its size is %1$d B instead of 64 B.
Signature mismatch: the image was modified or signed with another key. Installation cancelled.
The latest release has no firmware for this reader
The release has several matching files — pick one manually
The downloaded file doesn’t look like firmware
The release has no signature file (.bin.sig) — FolioLink does not install such firmware
No connection to GitHub. Check the internet connection and try again.
The image (%1$s) is older than the reader’s firmware (%2$s). Rolling back can lose features and fixes.
The image (%1$s) is the same version as the reader’s firmware.
The image is built for “%1$s”, the reader is “%2$s”. A firmware for another board may not start.
The image doesn’t state its version; it can’t be compared with the reader’s firmware (%1$s).
